description: List Stork's built-in text-to-speech voices for talking photo videos (id, name, language, gender, preview URL). Free, no key needed. 38 languages, among them English, Spanish, Portuguese, Arabic, French, Russian, Hindi, Urdu, Italian, Turkish, German, Japanese, Korean, Chinese, Indonesian, Polish, Ukrainian, Persian and Bengali; the list returns every language code.
name: stork_talking_photo_voices
